nodes.name: Post total failure
nodes.notes: Wired from the error output of a node upstream of any per-point result (e.g. the split/lookup step throwing before any item completes). Reserved for a total failure -- see the contract note on the lookup node. A partial failure must go through "Post ranks back" instead, with measured:false on the points that failed.
